messages:
Sam: FYI saw ~2.3k 413s from the embeddings route in the last 15m after the units-header change. Console shows a big unattributed 413 spike. Anyone else seeing this?
Maya: I can repro in logs — most 413s are from clients sending compressed ndarrays (gzip) and NOT including X-Units. Router fast-path trusts header and skips payload inspect -> we end up erroring.
Raj: I think the router logic is doing this:
```python
if req.headers.get("X-Units"):
    units = int(req.headers["X-Units"])
else:
    units = estimate_from_body(req.body)  # fails on gzip
if units > ROUTER_SOFT_LIMIT:
    raise Http413()
```
Maya: estimate_from_body tries to parse JSON arrays and falls over when body bytes are gzipped. We didn't catch that exception, so it bubbled up as a 413.
Ellie: Console telemetry didn't have a 'units_source' tag so the 413s show as unattributed. We should emit units_source=header|estimate|unknown from the router.
Sam: For a quick mitigation, should router fallback to decompression+estimate if header absent OR route to slowpath when estimate fails? Which is lower risk?
Raj: Lower risk = route to slowpath when there's uncertainty. I'll change the code to catch exceptions from estimate_from_body, set units_source="unknown", and route to slowpath + emit metric.
Maya: I'll add the console tag and a temporary alert on `unattributed_413_rate > 0.5% for 5m`.
Sam: @Raj can you also add a tiny test that simulates gzip payloads and asserts we don't throw 413 in the canary path? And log `units_source=unknown` clearly.
Raj: Yep — PR #8421 includes tests that gzip an array and ensure we route slowpath. Deploying to canary now :rocket:
deploy-bot: deploy started canary embedding-router v2.3.1 -> infra-canary-us-east-1
Raj: Canary logs look promising — 413s from that cohort dropped ~90%. Console now shows units_source breakdown so we can see header vs estimate vs unknown. Need follow-up to ask SDKs to populate X-Units for compressed payloads.
Ellie: I'll update the rollout note and add a console card that shows per-tenant avg units/token so PMs can understand cost impact.
Maya: I'll draft a short SDK doc: "If you send compressed embeddings payloads, include X-Units or we may route you to slowpath/emit unknown units."
Sam: Thanks everyone. Monitor for 1h and then promote if stable. :thumbsup:
